findings.claim: The accepted v0.5 model defines twelve local natal essences e_p within a sparse global natal graph G_0; the natal base is fixed under temporal transitions.
Temporal input u_(p,t) and response r_(p,t) are separate objects; the response is conditional on natal essence, temporal input, system mode, neighborhood and context.

The v2.2 plan's N, E_decade, E_year, tau_t and M0 can be crosswalked to the accepted model only at the stated object level; the crosswalk does not authorize a new source primitive or a universal composition operator.
QuickRead scope slots are request/coverage units, not the natal state graph itself. NATAL slots and temporal slots carry explicit domains, time layers and required evidence namespaces.

A non-NATAL response/manifestation slot must require TEMPORAL evidence, and temporal response/manifestation slots require both CANONICAL and TEMPORAL namespaces; temporal evidence must match the requested layer.

The main reader accepts only supported, source-reviewed palace ledgers with direct visual review, explicit promotion disposition, traceable source location and exact time-layer match; CASE_SUPPORT_ONLY, held, uncertain and mismatched-layer rows are excluded.
DetailedRead requires exactly twelve NATAL domain slots and keeps DECADE/YEAR temporal slots separate; its staged thematic presentation does not itself create shared temporal semantics.

The PL3-T compiler requires explicit natal antecedents, an explicit positive temporal condition and temporal atoms bound to the selected reaction layer. It consumes a normalized snapshot and does not infer source semantics from free text.

The accepted WP07B handoff records 44 temporal candidates and zero eligible under the current compiler contract; this is an existing source/normalization blocker, not permission for Core to relax Product requirements.

CA09-851 is a multi-year consecutive annual-window subtype with approximate duration evidence and undefined favorable-period criterion; TP03-248 is a same-year antecedent branch with an event-consequence path and a CASE_SUPPORT_ONLY parent. They are not one persistence operator.
GAP-006 separates category membership, activation, relation and interaction; period-level favorable wording does not define a reusable GOOD_YEAR predicate.
Source-native negative wording is not equivalent to missing a positive fact in an incomplete snapshot or to a proven absence over a complete observation universe.

The WP03 synthesis reports distinct decade/year meanings, short-term annual triggers, longer decade paths and state-dependent reactions; these findings support separate layers but do not define a universal DECADE-to-YEAR composition rule.
A2-R1 memory records only source-explicit acquired dispositions or path-dependent gates with bounded persistence scopes; no numeric decay, retention weight or generic recurrence is permitted.
The approved migration first-three-years rule uses an externally supplied confirmed-settlement clock; it is a specific event-relative window, not a general timer or a substitute for D_t/H_t memory.

The Product recovery snapshot describes the NATAL essence graph as partial and not production-ready; this is a Product implementation/readiness status, not a reason to rebuild or revise Core's accepted v0.5 semantics.
